description: One entry in full by id: body, every source with locator and edition, supersedes / superseded_by, subjects, related entries, and the review record {round, reviewer, decision, stale}. An investigation also carries sections[] {heading, chars}, sources[] as rows {n, locator, title, edition, published, fetched, language, same_as}, claims[] (its findings with bodies) and open_questions[]. A write-up can run past what one call may carry: pass section (a heading; "answer" = the write-up without the harness's sections; "workers", "references", "evidence") to get one section, and offset / max_chars for a window of the body.

id.description: F-? finding, I-? investigation, A-? article, or a raw file name.

max_chars.description: Optional: at most this many characters of the body; chars and truncated say what was left.

offset.description: Optional: start of the body window, in characters.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

section.description: Optional: one section by heading, or "answer" for the write-up alone.

name: library_get
